title: Custom Plate Transfer
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required parameters such as source and destination plates, volumes, and any other settings as prompted by the protocol.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the Waters 2 mL 96‑well plate, appropriate tip rack, and any other labware on the robot deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, run the calibration routine for the labware, tip rack, and the P300 multi‑channel GEN2 electronic pipette, following on‑screen prompts.

steps.title: Perform sample transfer
steps.instruction: The robot will pre‑wet the tip, then aspirate and dispense 300 µL three consecutive times, followed by a single transfer of 750 µL to the second plate using a 30 µL air gap, then blow out and touch tip at the destination.

substeps.instruction: Pre‑wet tip by aspirating and dispensing a small volume
Aspirate 300 µL from source and dispense back, repeat for a total of three cycles
Aspirate 750 µL from source, create a 30 µL air gap, dispense into destination well
Blow out remaining liquid and touch tip to the well surface

steps.title: Start run
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT App to execute the protocol.
